Name: DM Voice Pack - Chinese (zh) No Longer Maintained
Author: Darkmushu1
Description:
I'm quitting modding to explore other things in life, whoever wants to take over the project and or maintain just let me know and I can add a redirect link here to your Nexus mod page.

Stardew Valley voice over to dub Chinese dialogue for Vanilla characters. When dialogue box appear voices will be played. Cannot play without the Voice Over Framework Mod. This mod uses AI generated the audio for the voice over.

Models
I've been informed this pack does sound funny or ugly and so if you know of an better AI to use for better results let me know. 

[b]About This Voice Pack[/b]
All audio in this voice pack was generated using [b]licensed voices from ElevenLabs’ Voice Library[/b] while I held an [b]active commercial creator license (Scale Plan)[/b]. These voices are provided by professional voice actors who have chosen to share their voices publicly through ElevenLabs.
Each time a library voice is used, the original voice actor receives [b]royalties[/b] based on usage, ensuring fair compensation for their contribution.
This project complies fully with ElevenLabs’ terms of service and supports ethical use of AI voice technology.


Due to limited number of Library voices available for the language "Chinese" on ElevenLabs there only enough voices to dub some characters.
